name: Bayer Leverkusen 2023/24 (Xabi Alonso)
scopeNote: Bayer Leverkusen 2023/24 under Xabi Alonso: unbeaten Bundesliga title, DFB-Pokal win (final 25 May 2024 vs Kaiserslautern), Europa League final lost 0-3 to Atalanta (22 May 2024). Period runs from the DFB-Pokal first round at Teutonia Ottensen (12 Aug 2023) to the Pokal final. Sources call the system a 3-4-2-1 (Bundesliga.com) that is a 5-2-3 out of possession (Transfer Hub, Coaches' Voice), with a back four against the ball in Europa League group games and for the Bayern match of 10 Feb 2024; Coaches' Voice calls it 3-4-3. 2024/25 pieces (e.g. Bundesliga.com on Bayern 21 Feb 2025, Yahoo on Milan Oct 2024) were read and excluded. Several event dates are season-level (YYYY/YY) because the articles describe the whole season.
openQuestions: Formation label differs by source: 3-4-2-1 (Bundesliga.com Taktik-Check), 3-4-3 (Coaches' Voice), 5-2-3 out of possession (Transfer Hub). Same structure, different counting.
Man-marking high then space-based defending (Transfer Hub, March 2024) is one analyst's reading; no coach statement found confirming the pressing scheme.
Alonso primary interviews on tactics (Coaches' Voice, Players' Tribune) not mined; statedView holds only two in-period quotes.
Dates of first match (12 Aug 2023, from Sport1) and Pokal final (25 May 2024, from Wikipedia) rest on single sources; the final date was not confirmed in a second mined page.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Alonso also shifted to a more permanent 3-4-3 shape at Leverkusen. Within this, he could either deploy two number 10s, with the width provided by the wing-backs, or a flatter front trio with the wing-backs then supporting deeper and narrower.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: bevorzugte 3-4-2-1-Formation ... Auf diese Formation setzte Alonso in diesem Spieljahr bislang in jeder Bundesliga-Partie. Vor Torwart Lukáš Hrádecký verteidigen drei Spieler im Abwehrzentrum, unterstützt von zwei zentralen Mittelfeldakteuren mit Xhaka und Argentiniens Weltmeister Exequiel Palacios.

sources.title: Tactical Analysis: Xabi Alonso's Bayer Leverkusen - Control Over Chaos
sources.evidence: while 5-2-3 is his system overall, they only defend in that shape and move into something else when in possession.

sources.title: Tactics Corner: How Alonso's Leverkusen neutralised Tuchel's Bayern
sources.evidence: Unlike normally, it wasn't the right-sided defender (Frimpong, or in this case Stanišić) who broke out from the back line to create a flat four, but Alejandro Grimaldo on the left. By going forward, he then formed a 4-2-3-1 formation in possession

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: Die Realformationen von Bayer 04 beim 4:0 gegen den 1. FC Union Berlin am vergangenen Spieltag zeigen, dass die Außenbahnspieler bei Ballbesitz der Werkself weit aufrücken.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: This adapted shape and personnel changes have allowed Leverkusen to dominate the ball for longer spells, increasing their average possession to 59 per cent after 18 games of the 2023/24 Bundesliga.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: Leverkusen hat durchschnittlich 58 Prozent Ballbesitz – nur der FC Bayern mehr – und sogar die meisten Zuspiele in der Bundesliga kommen mit 90 Prozent an.

sources.title: Transfer Gurus: Bayer Leverkusen's Simon Rolfes - Analytics FC
sources.evidence: The team had the highest average possession (61.8%) in the league and controlled the flow of the game. That control translated into the fewest shots faced (8.56 per 90 min) and the lowest expected goals against (29.9).

sources.title: Tactical Analysis: Xabi Alonso's Bayer Leverkusen - Control Over Chaos
sources.evidence: Alonso's men generally go for man-v-man marking when pressing high. The above image is a clear depiction of that. Once the opposition plays through or clears it out, they revert to space defending

sources.title: Tactical Analysis: Xabi Alonso's Bayer Leverkusen - Control Over Chaos
sources.evidence: With 238 high turnovers in the league (29 better than second-placed Bayern in this metric), they are dangerous with this method of winning the ball back high.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: The wing-backs aggressively jump out to press, as seen with the full-backs at Sociedad, but with Leverkusen's back five it has been rare that the double pivot is needed to cover.

sources.title: Tactics Corner - Bayer Leverkusen 2.0: Squad planning, 2024 tactics and unsung heroes
sources.evidence: Opponents like RB Leipzig planned to exploit Leverkusen by deploying a 4-2-2-2 with two No.10s and two ball-sided strikers creating an issue for Bayer's high press. Leipzig's plan initially held Leverkusen's juggernaut to just 0.2 xG, but Alonso adjusted near the end of the first half.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Leverkusen's organised block has often become a 5-2-3, with the two 10s narrowing alongside centre-forward Boniface (below). This limits central access, as seen with Sociedad, giving Leverkusen lots of defensive numbers, but also a solid platform to centrally transition and combine.

sources.title: Tactics Corner: How Alonso's Leverkusen neutralised Tuchel's Bayern
sources.evidence: Stanišić's inclusion allowed Leverkusen to create a back five out of players whose strengths lie in defending. ... This approach meant the Werkself were able to defend one-to-one against Bayern's front three and their high wing-backs

sources.title: Tactics Corner: How Alonso's Leverkusen neutralised Tuchel's Bayern
sources.evidence: But this time Alonso decided he wanted his team to form a solid defensive block and challenge Bayern to find a way through. They were even less eager to regain possession throughout, managing a ball recovery time of 22.6 seconds. That figure had stood at 18.7 seconds in the reverse fixture.

sources.title: Tactical Analysis: Xabi Alonso's Bayer Leverkusen - Control Over Chaos
sources.evidence: This is the standard 5-2-3 formation Leverkusen falls into when defending in a mid-block. ... There are hardly 15 yards between the last and the forward line.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: Taktisch diszipliniert kassierten die Leverkusener als eins von lediglich zwei Teams noch kein Tor bei einem Konter

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Despite Leverkusen not being a crossing team, they have made use of their widest players in the front line in transition. This has especially been the case when using a flatter front-line trio in a 3-4-3

sources.title: Analysing Alonso's unbeaten run vs. Bayern Munich
sources.evidence: Leverkusen would finish the game with an average 38 per cent possession, their lowest during the season by that point. They would limit Bayern to an Expected Goals (xG) tally of just 0.3, underlining their defensive excellence throughout the win.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: In Alonso's first season with Bayer Leverkusen, his side recorded the second-lowest number of crosses in the Bundesliga. This indicated his preference for penetrating and progressing centrally.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: Wenn Leverkusen die Kugel aber verliert, ziehen sich die Flügelmänner Richtung Mittellinie zurück.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: In 29 Prozent der Fälle attackieren sie über links, in 20 über halblinks, in 18 über halbrechts und in 33 über rechts.

sources.title: Taktik-Check: Was macht die Werkself unter Alonso so stark?
sources.evidence: Bayer erzielte bereits acht Tore nach Standards: vier nach Ecken, zwei nach Freistößen und zwei per Elfmeter – eine weitere ligaweite Bestmarke!

sources.title: Analysing Alonso's unbeaten run vs. Bayern Munich
sources.evidence: Leverkusen respond with a blockbuster of their own, Grimaldo curling in a picture-perfect free-kick after 24 minutes to equalise matters.

sources.title: Xabi Alonso's coaching career analysed - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: A significant aspect of their superb start to the 2023/24 Bundesliga has been Leverkusen's ability to score first. In their initial 18 matches, they scored the first goal on 14 occasions. Alonso has then had more flexibility with his game plan, giving the possibility to defend in a more compact block and counter against opposition chasing the game.

sources.title: Analysing Alonso's unbeaten run vs. Bayern Munich
sources.evidence: Perhaps unexpectedly the game-changing substitution from Alonso was replacing Robert Andrich with Palacios. ... Palacios would haunt Bayern once again from the spot, to deliver a dramatic late equaliser, the first of 17 stoppage-time goals Leverkusen would go on to score during the season.

sources.title: Tactics Corner: How Alonso's Leverkusen neutralised Tuchel's Bayern
sources.evidence: Alonso told the media ahead of kick-off that Frimpong's omission was down to "tactical reasons". He later explained in more detail: "We can dominate the game, but sometimes we also have to wait and defend in a compact way."

sources.title: CL-Duell: Wie Leverkusen die Bayern entzaubern will - ZDFheute
sources.evidence: Vor allem im Bundesliga-Spiel gegen die Bayern am 10. Februar 2024 erlangte Alonso ein Taktikdiplom mit Sternchen. Er ließ mit einer Viererkette und zwei defensiven sowie zwei offensiven Mittelfeldspielern, dem Halbstürmer Tella und dem Zentrumsangreifer Amine Adli spielen.

sources.title: Tactics Corner - Bayer Leverkusen 2.0: Squad planning, 2024 tactics and unsung heroes
sources.evidence: Alonso also demonstrated that he is flexible and adaptable based on opponent quality, while retaining many of the key principles - positional play, quick but methodical ball progression, associative play in the final third and immediate counter-pressing
